findings.note: Item 1 answer 'Living in the house alone does not give you that authority.' states a legal conclusion about who holds authority to sell as certain. No ledger claim supports it (the unit cites no claims), 'that authority' has no antecedent, and the answer has no confirm-with-a-professional language. Rewrite so it does not assert who does or does not hold authority, and tell the reader to confirm authority to sell with a real estate attorney or title company.
The brief asks for 5-7 FAQ items; the unit has 3. Item 1 does not actually answer its question. Wording and coverage preference, not a fact issue.

required_actions: Reword item 1 answer so it does not state a legal conclusion about authority as certain, and add confirm-with-an-attorney-or-title-company language.
